# loadArtifact

abstract suspend fun [loadArtifact](load-artifact.html)(sessionKey: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html), filename: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), version: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)? = null): [Part](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-part/index.html)?

#### Return

#### Parameters

 _session Key_

identifies the session that owns the artifact.

_filename_

_version_
